cards.backContent: phổ biến; được nhiều người yêu thích
cards.extra2: popular with/among + people — được ưa chuộng bởi
cards.example: The singer is very popular among teenagers.
She is a talented young musician.
He can play several musical instruments.

cards.extra1: win/receive an award — giành/nhận giải thưởng
cards.extra2: award somebody something — trao cho ai cái gì
cards.example: The band won an award for its new song.

cards.extra1: play the trumpet — chơi kèn trumpet
cards.example: He learned to play the trumpet at school.
Many teenagers enjoy listening to pop music.

cards.backContent: đăng tải lên mạng; lần/tệp tải lên
cards.extra1: upload a video/photo/file — đăng video/ảnh/tệp lên mạng
cards.example: She uploaded her first music video last week.

cards.extra1: get/million views — có/đạt hàng triệu lượt xem
cards.example: The video received thousands of views in one day.
The students will perform on stage tonight.
The audience enjoyed the band's live performance.
Each performer had five minutes on stage.

cards.extra1: judge a competition/performance — chấm một cuộc thi/phần biểu diễn
cards.extra2: judgement (n) — sự đánh giá; phán xét
make a judgement — đưa ra đánh giá
cards.example: The judges made their judgement after the final performance.

cards.extra1: live audience — khán giả trực tiếp
cards.example: The audience clapped loudly at the end of the song.

cards.backContent: người xem qua truyền hình hoặc màn hình
cards.extra2: online/TV viewer — người xem trực tuyến/truyền hình
cards.example: Millions of viewers watched the show online.
